pixel_convention: x right, y DOWN, origin at top-left of the 2560x2560 image

camera.motion: static (no pan/shake: static objects identical between frames; frame 13 used as clean background, diff outside the drop is noise only)
camera.view: low side view, slightly upward-looking (bottle base slightly below pedestal top edge); drop falls in a plane facing the camera; no visible ground plane or horizon

objects.name: drop
objects.description: single translucent amber/brown teardrop, pointed tip UP and rounded bottom, falls from the glass pipette tip straight down to the right of the bottle
objects.reference_point: centre of the drop's bounding box (taken as the object origin)

size_px.note: constant shape (rigid-like) in all frames; measured on clean frames 2-5

objects.name: dropper_pipette
objects.description: glass pipette with white rubber bulb/cap, lying tilted across the bottle mouth, tip pointing down-right; the drop hangs from its tip at frame 0

image_position_px.glass_tube: from about (930, 330) to tip ring centre (1172, 510); tube axis tilted ~37 deg below horizontal

objects.reliability: approximate +/- 5-10 px (read from grid images; transparent glass edges)

objects.name: bottle
objects.description: frosted glass bottle with amber/orange liquid, vertical text SKYNOVA on its right side; stands on the pedestal

image_position_px.base_y: 1025 (front-left, at pedestal edge) to 1048 (lowest point of base rim)

objects.reliability: +/- 5 px for side edges (frosted glass edges soft)

objects.name: pedestal
objects.description: large light-grey/white rectangular block on the left whose top surface the bottle stands on; extends past the left and bottom image borders

image_position_px.front_face_right_edge_x: 954 at y=1100, 945 at y=1500, ~941 at y=2500 (slight perspective lean)
image_position_px.side_face_right_edge_x: ~1000 at top (thin darker side face 954-1000), faint
image_position_px.visible_front_face: x 0-954, y 1026-2560 (cut by image edges), so its full size is NOT visible

objects.reliability: top edge +/- 1 px; right edge +/- 3 px

objects.name: background_wall
objects.description: plain grey studio backdrop with vignette (darker at the bottom and corners); no markings

events.event: drop pinch-off / release from pipette tip (drop still touching tip, at rest)
drop passes level of pedestal top edge (y 1026)
drop leaves the image through the bottom edge; no impact/splash seen

perspective: 2D scene: drop path is a vertical line at x~1175.6 px in a plane facing the camera. Drop apparent size constant (86x57 px) during the whole fall, so no measurable depth change.
